raw_run_output.harness_type_note: The external side-effect service (service.mjs) is SIMULATED - a local child process with its own SQLite durable log, not a real remote system. No real capability/policy implementation exists yet (Phase 8/9 unstarted), so authorization is recorded but not enforced.

results.limitation: REJECTED trustworthy only because the SIMULATED service has a reliable status check; a real system without one must degrade to MANUAL_REVIEW

results.note: detected via unreadable-file (header corruption), not via PRAGMA integrity_check on a subtler corruption - see E5-02-RESULT.md Corrections

corrections_made_during_run: service_log table missing on never-dispatched service DB - fixed with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS at query time
stale sentinel files from a prior invocation caused a false-positive premature kill - fixed by sweeping sentinels per trial
checkpoint-corruption case initially undetected (mid-file byte corruption landed in unallocated page space) - fixed by corrupting the SQLite header magic bytes instead

response-lost-after-real-side-effect flaked once out of 3 initial runs (kill lost the race against the SIMULATED service's own synchronous exit) - fixed by widening the post-commit window to 60ms; 5 consecutive re-runs clean after the fix
